canonical_project: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad High Performance Computing Facility / Campus Data Centre
notes: Official IIT(ISM) Dhanbad R&D brochure documents a High Performance Computing Facility (Rs 10 crore, CPU cluster ~50 nodes / 2,264 cores / 240 TB storage) for research and data computing needs. Institutional computing facility rather than commercial colocation; no MW-scale commercial datacenter project found in Dhanbad in public sources.
